articles.title: Sky's USDS stablecoin shrinks 35% as $1.5 billion exits reserves after illicit-finance report
articles.snippet: USDS held its $1 peg as a large holder linked to Poloniex withdrew much of decentralized protocol Sky's USDC liquidity backing its stablecoins.

articles.title: Sky Protocol sees $2 billion in stablecoin withdrawals, disputes illicit fund claims
articles.snippet: Sky says its USDS stablecoin held its $1 value despite more than $2 billion in withdrawals, as it disputes a report linking the protocol to illicit activity.

articles.title: DBS bets it can lose the deposit and keep the client
articles.snippet: The Singapore bank earned a record $208 million in transaction services fees in the third quarter — now it’s helping companies turn deposits into stablecoins they can spend without it.

articles.title: MoonPay seeks US bank charter for stablecoin, custody services
articles.snippet: MoonPay’s proposed national trust bank would offer stablecoin issuance and redemption, reserve management and digital asset custody under federal oversight.

articles.title: MoonPay Applies for National Trust Bank Charter to Grow Custody and Stablecoin Business
articles.snippet: The crypto payments firm joins a rush of crypto companies seeking federal trust charters, which face growing political scrutiny.
